behavior: voiceOverlayCompatibility defaults false, validates strictly as a boolean, persists as a device-only preference, and is excluded from account/server preference synchronization. Existing interaction preferences remain stored while the mode is active.

The same native HUD remains focusable:false and is shown with showInactive. Compatibility forces native mouse passthrough, denies unlock/drag, hides shaped action children and closes the focusable composer. It does not create another window, inject into a game or add fullscreen/anti-cheat support.

Compatibility entry clears pending inbox/chat/reply focus intents and cancels outstanding composer acknowledgements. All action, notification, chat and composer availability checks and trusted-main confirmation routes deny interaction while active. Late native did-finish-load callbacks cannot revive hit regions or focus the main app. An already-dispatched main-renderer/network send cannot be retroactively unsent by changing this display policy.

Main-renderer action hooks check live compatibility before and across awaits; eligibility and opaque grants are revoked on entry. Voice action sessions include a synchronous policy epoch so old grants stay stale after normal mode resumes. Normal-mode restoration never implicitly unlocks or focuses the HUD.

Compatibility also releases the global overlay shortcut, rather than leaving an OS-reserved chord with a no-op callback. Native shortcut suspension rejects late registration while active; registration epochs reject old callbacks even after the same chord is registered again. Failed unregister is exposed through the existing shortcut status instead of reporting success. Other independent call hotkeys such as PTT are unchanged.

The settings toggle and disabled interaction controls explain the read-only limitation and preserve choices. The renderer independently suppresses stale interaction flags and shows a read-only indicator; chat/activity/notification display privacy rules and existing layout storage remain in place.
